//: Deliberately does not extend ../../tsconfig.json. That file declares only `files: []` and project `references`, neither of which this package inherits (references are not inherited through extends), so the extends contributed nothing — while causing Playwright to fail loading any config here with 'Failed to resolve references path ./packages/types', which stopped the entire e2e suite from running.
//runtime-paths: The @sparql-query-lib/* entries below map to source, not dist. CI typechecks before it builds, so resolving a sibling package through its exports map would make this package's typecheck depend on somebody having built that sibling first — which is exactly how `nuxi typecheck` went red on a runtime that had never been built. nuxt.config.ts carries the same mappings for the bundler; this file is what nuxi typecheck reads.
//baseUrl: baseUrl is deprecated in TypeScript 7 but still required here: dropping it changes module resolution enough that @nuxt/schema's optional webpack peer types stop resolving. Silenced rather than migrated.
//module: Nuxt's own generated .nuxt/tsconfig.json (extended by nothing here, per the note above) resolves modules with 'preserve'/'bundler', matching what Vite actually does. Without an explicit module here, tsc's default (CommonJS) rejected the `with { type: 'json' }` import attribute in edgeFlowTypeDefaults.ts.
//include-nuxt-node: nuxt.node.d.ts (not nuxt.d.ts) is the file that references types/modules.d.ts, which is where Nuxt's codegen declares the `shadcn` key on NuxtConfig for shadcn-nuxt's module options. Without it in scope, nuxt.config.ts's `shadcn: {...}` block has no known type to match.
